limits.response_limit_note: 10,000,000 applies to all sources except the approved EU-only 32,000,000 override; combined 50,000,000 includes failed attempts. Limits apply per invocation; the coordinator subtracts earlier session bytes before a fresh invocation. EU has 180 seconds per absolute request deadline and 240 seconds per source invocation. Wikidata has a 90-second request limit within its unchanged 120-second source deadline; other sources retain 30/120 seconds. The coordinator selected one attempt for the authorized Wikidata investigation; the current pinned query selects at most 20 service-order candidates within the unchanged 200-group retention ceiling. No further request follows automatically from unused byte allowance.
